questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Fan : Blade :: Car : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The second word is a component or part of the first word.**

Here,

Fan : Blade → A blade is a component of a fan.

Similarly,

Car : ? → Steering is a component of a car.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Steering"**.

questions.question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All blankets are bedsheet.

II. No bedsheet is a curtain.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some bedsheet are blanket.

II. No curtain is a blanket.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. All blankets are bedsheet.

II. No bedsheet is a curtain.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0afecd92a17776a4acf572cc88afdb78f7654a2b69aed4091173eb96764fe28.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bedsheet are blanket - True (All blankets are bedsheet it means some blankets will be also bedsheet).

II. No curtain is a blanket - True (Because, All blankets are bedsheet and No bedsheet is a curtain, so all the Blankets are part of Bedsheet that is not Curtain, it also means No curtain is a blanket).

So, Both conclusion I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs the given equation will be correct?

46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41
questions.solution:
Given equation: 46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) × and +

Given: 46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 46 × 28 + 2 - __**7 ÷ 13**__ = 41

⇒ __**46 × 28**__ + 2 - 0.54 = 41

⇒ __**1288 + 2**__ - 0.54 = 41

⇒ __1290 - 0.54__ = 41

⇒ 1289.46 ≠ 41

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 2) ÷ and -**

Given: 46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 46 + __**28 × 2 ÷ 7**__ - 13 = 41

⇒ __**46 + 8**__ - 13 = 41

⇒ __54** - 13**__ = 41

**⇒ 41 = 41**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 3) + and ÷ 

Given: 46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**46 ÷ 28 × 2**__ - 7 + 13 = 41

⇒ __**3.29**__ - 7 __**+ 13**__ = 41

⇒ __16.29** - 7**__ = 41

⇒ 9.29 ≠ 41

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷ and × 

Given: 46 + 28 × 2 - 7 ÷ 13 = 41

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 46 + __**28 ÷ 2**__ - 7 × 13 = 41

⇒ 46 + 14 - __**7 × 13**__ = 41

⇒ __**46 + 14**__ - 91 = 41

⇒ __60 - 91__ = 41

⇒ - 31 ≠ 41

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'PAIN' is written as '20' and 'HER' is written as '11'. How will 'TIER' be written in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(**Sum of the place value of all numbers) - 20 = Code of the word.

'PAIN' is written as '20'

⇒ (16 + 1 + 9 + 14) - 20

⇒ 40 - 20 = 20.

'HER' is written as '11'

⇒ (8 + 5 + 18) - 20

⇒ 31 - 20 = 11.

Similarly, for '**TIER**'

**⇒ (20 + 9 + 5 + 18) - 20**

**⇒ 52 - 20 = 32.**

So, 'TIER' will be written as '32'.

Hence, the correct answer is "32".

Logic: **Each letter in the cluster is obtained by moving three positions forward in the English alphabet.**

Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(80, 72, 64)

(64, 56, 48)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(**1st number + 3rd number) **÷ 2** = 2nd number.

Now,

For (80, 72, 64)

→ (80 + 64) ÷ 2

→ 144 ÷ 2 = 72.

For (64, 56, 48)

→ (64 + 48) ÷ 2

→ 112 ÷ 2 = 56.

Similarly, for **(63, 56, 49)**

**→ (63 + 49) ÷ 2**

**→ 112 ÷ 2 = 56.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
